_comment: VRAM-lean fallback: union {3,7} = 2 runtime states, 9 bs-captures (vs 13 for adaptive_flashnext.json, 8 for the static config). Boot this first if the 4-state config runs out of VRAM during graph capture. up/down hysteresis place the bs1 n3->n7 step-up at its own break-even ema*=1.50 (not n3->n5's).
